record.label: D27 shared-vs-split arena alias discriminator
record.summary: Shared and split arena spellings have the exact same 58-call operation inventory and output bytes. Splitting saves only 0.683 ms median residual while allocating 2,320,941,056 extra bytes and leaving about 222 MB below the 8 GiB ceiling. It misses the frozen 15 ms credibility gate and is not board-safe.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed at HOLD_NO_SUCCESSOR: the alias-only split changes no arithmetic, provides sub-millisecond median timing benefit, and consumes nearly all remaining memory margin.
